character.description: Pixel Wave Stage 1 connected coral reef background patch family

far_reef.action: three distinct static far-background reef shelf patch variants, one complete connected patch per slot; broad low horizontal rock silhouette, sparse tiny coral marks, low detail and low contrast; every patch has a solid rocky underside and remains fully isolated from neighboring slots

mid_reef.action: three distinct static midground coral reef patch variants, one complete connected patch per slot; layered blue rock base with readable peach branching coral and lavender tube coral; varied silhouettes but the same material palette, outline weight and pixel density; solid connected underside

near_reef.action: three distinct static foreground reef patch variants, one complete connected patch per slot; darker indigo rock mass, larger peach and lavender coral silhouettes, strong stair-step clusters, restrained highlights, solid connected underside

shell_landmark.action: two distinct static shell landmark patch variants, one complete connected patch per slot; a large warm cream and pink ridged seashell resting on a dark blue reef-rock base with a small coral accent; shell silhouette remains the focal shape and the whole patch is connected

style: authentic native-resolution hard-edged pixel art matching the accepted reef base exactly: large countable logical pixels, deliberate stair-step curves, compact color clusters, limited indigo-blue rock with peach and lavender coral palette, no antialiasing, no gradients, no detached debris
